headline: Web resources curate sequences, hosts and ligands across toxins, avian flu and plant viruses
label: Integrated Curated Biological Resources
summary: Three new resources link sequence records to structures, hosts, surveillance or antiviral data, with LLM or AI assistance in two of them.
synthesis: The common thread is integrative curation: each resource assembles heterogeneous records into one queryable platform. ToxINsight links 2,078 snake venom toxin entries to 2,540 3D structures, with alignment and ligand-binding analysis. PlantVirDisConDB connects plant virus sequences to hosts, diseases, targets and antiviral assay data, and adds AI-assisted molecule-virus activity prioritization. Roost combines over 1,300 HPAI publications, surveillance detections and 2,000+ avian genome assemblies, using LLM-assisted literature handling. Structure anchoring is explicit only for ToxINsight in the provided summaries; Roost is organized around host genomics and literature. What is new is the pairing of domain-specific curation with computational assistance, rather than a shared data type or assay format.
